chapter_seo_title: Gao Zhijian's Secret Military Cultivation & Bai Lingmiao's Cryptic Letter – Daodegui Chapter 371
chapter_meta_description: As Chun Xiaoman fails at spirit-medium chants, Gao Zhijian secretly trains in Peng Longteng's blood-sealed military manual. Then a letter from Bai Lingmiao arrives—in Li Huowang's handwriting.
og_title: The Blood-Sealed Manual & A Letter That Says Too Little
og_description: Gao Zhijian practices forbidden military cultivation while Chun Xiaoman chants alone. A letter from Bai Lingmiao brings relief—and then Gao Zhijian recognizes the handwriting.
twitter_title: That letter was NOT written by Bai Lingmiao.
twitter_description: Gao Zhijian is secretly training in Peng Longteng's military art. A letter arrives from the missing Bai Lingmiao. Gao Zhijian identifies the handwriting as Li Huowang's.

lore_anchors.definition: In military cultivation, a psychic force generated by slaughter and battle intent; when condensed, it can kill insects at a glance and manifests as visible blood-qi.
A martial cultivation path derived from the Warring States Military Strategy School; it uses killing intent instead of qi and turns the practitioner into a living weapon.
A folk-Buddhist/Daoist concept where celestial departments are analogized to medical ingredients; each "flavor" corresponds to a specific protective spirit or heavenly bureau.
